narrative.northStar: Bàn điều phối có trách nhiệm
narrative.overview: People scan stock, approve proposals and record actual handovers; status and accountability lead, decoration does not. Vietnamese copy explains errors, assumptions and next actions.
dos: Do keep task status, actor, actual quantity and evidence visible.
Do expose data provenance and estimated-route limitations.
donts: Don't cover active controls with toast overlays.
Don't fabricate business metrics, customers or AI confidence.
Don't replace the operational interface with marketing decoration.
